subject: [PATCH 40/60] mm/page_alloc: let MM callers select the local private zonelist

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The patch introduces a new flag to allow MM callers to select the local private zonelist independently of __GFP_THISNODE. This is intended to improve memory allocation behavior for private memory allocations.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series introduces a new flag, ALLOC_ZONELIST_PRIVATE, which allows MM callers to select the local private zonelist independently of __GFP_THISNODE. The goal is to improve memory allocation behavior for private memory allocations, which have no reserves to grant.
